description: Held-out lens set (D-024). 100 real items captured from the 24 live v1 feeds on 2026-11-07 (LiveFeedsTest -Pfg.capture) in a second capture, excluding every title already in lens-testset.json, sampled per source with a fixed seed (4 per source, the rest at random), and hand-labelled with the same guide BEFORE any D-024 rule change. Never used for tuning: rules are tuned on lens-testset.json only and measured here. Frozen: change it only on purpose, in its own commit.

labelGuide.FUNDING: A company raised, closed or is raising money (equity, debt, grants), M&A or an exit, an IPO, or a new VC/startup fund; funding round-ups.
labelGuide.LAUNCHES: A new product, company or feature is launched or shown (Show HN, Product Hunt, 'launches', 'unveils', emerging from stealth).
labelGuide.TRENDS: Market or sector analysis, regulation or policy, layoffs or shutdowns, data reports (including funding data reports).
labelGuide.PLAYBOOKS: Advice, how-tos, lessons and first-hand stories or interviews from founders, operators and investors.
